summary: Moderate: wget security, bug fix, and enhancement update
details:
The wget packages provide the GNU Wget file retrieval utility for HTTP, HTTPS, and FTP protocols.

Security Fix(es):

* wget: GNU Wget: Heap buffer overflow via server-supplied filename leads to memory corruption (CVE-2026-58471)

* wget: GNU Wget: Arbitrary code execution or denial of service via crafted HTML attribute (CVE-2026-58472)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* wget async unsafe code in signal handler context [rhel-9.8.z] (JIRA:Rocky Linux-220497)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
